text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock C at a loss was painful, but I should judge a holding by its prospects and my original reasons for buying—not hold it just to avoid admitting a mistake.","Selling Stocks E, B, and D for gains felt good, but locking in a profit alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider each stock’s outlook and my overall plan.","I rarely trade and have stayed invested through ordinary fluctuations, so I should avoid reacting to every dip or gain and make changes only when my reasons for holding have materially changed."]}
